categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor silicon wafer industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon wafers including 300mm polished and epitaxial wafers, 200mm and smaller wafers, SOI wafers, and piezoelectric thin film substrate materials. It serves as a leading domestic supplier with a comprehensive product portfolio covering various wafer sizes and types, targeting applications in logic, memory, image sensors, power devices, sensors, RF chips, analog chips, and discrete devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered multiple core technologies including single crystal growth (Czochralski and magnetic field Czochralski methods), thermal field simulation and design, large-diameter silicon ingot slicing, high-precision rounding, low-stress wire cutting, chemical etching, double-sided grinding, edge grinding, double-sided and single-sided polishing, wafer cleaning, epitaxy, and SOI wafer fabrication. It has developed near-perfect 300mm single crystal growth and ultra-flat polishing processes, and established an internationally advanced 300mm silicon material extreme characterization system, supporting rapid R&D iteration and product quality improvement.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's key customers include major global semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, STMicroelectronics, TowerJazz, as well as leading domestic chip manufacturers like SMIC, Hua Hong Grace, Huali Microelectronics, and China Resources Microelectronics. Its products serve end markets across North America, Europe, China, and other Asian regions, covering applications in storage, logic, image processing, general processors, power devices, sensors, RF chips, analog chips, and discrete devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant production facilities in Shanghai and Taiyuan, and has international subsidiaries including Okmetic Oy in Finland and other European entities. It maintains global sales and customer support teams in Europe, North America, Japan, and Hong Kong, reflecting a high degree of internationalization in its operations and market reach.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a manufacturer and supplier of semiconductor silicon wafers, which are critical raw materials for downstream semiconductor chip fabrication. It provides wafers to chip manufacturers and also engages in some midstream activities such as epitaxial wafer production and SOI wafer fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes sustained high R&D investment focusing on advancing 300mm wafer technology, including ultra-low oxygen, high resistivity, low defect, and ultra-low resistivity wafers. It is developing high-end silicon-based materials for power, RF, and silicon photonics applications, expanding SOI wafer capabilities, and advancing piezoelectric thin film substrates. Strategic priorities include capacity expansion, technology upgrades, product diversification, and strengthening the domestic semiconductor materials ecosystem through innovation and international cooperation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor silicon wafers and related materials to downstream chip manufacturers. The company also earns income from entrusted processing services and investment income from equity holdings. Sales are mostly conducted via direct negotiation with major customers, supplemented by limited agency sales for smaller clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor silicon wafer industry is oligopolistic, dominated by five major players including Shin-Etsu Chemical, SUMCO, GlobalWafers, Siltronic, and SK Siltron, which hold about 90% of the market. The company positions itself as a leading domestic supplier aiming to close the technology and scale gap with these global leaders by expanding production capacity, enhancing technology, and increasing market share both domestically and internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.39 billion, a 6.18% increase from 2023, driven mainly by a 72% surge in 300mm wafer shipments. However, net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 970 million due to market price declines, inventory adjustments, and goodwill impairment of about RMB 300 million related to acquisitions. The company is in a growth phase with significant capital expenditures on capacity expansion projects, including a RMB 13.2 billion investment in 300mm wafer capacity upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a comprehensive and diversified product portfolio with advanced technology capabilities, including large-diameter 300mm wafers and specialty wafers like SOI and piezoelectric substrates. It emphasizes high-quality, domestically produced silicon wafers that meet stringent customer requirements across multiple chip applications. Its integrated R&D and production capabilities, combined with a globalized supply chain and customer base, provide a one-stop silicon materials service, enhancing supply security and reducing reliance on imports.
